ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the text above the problem figure says “AgNO3(aq.) gradually added to aqueous KCl solution”, requiring determining the curve of conductance Λ versus AgNO3 volume. Below there are four candidate graphs, with the vertical axis labeled Λ and the horizontal axis labeled volume. The four graphs present different shapes respectively: there is a monotonically increasing curve, a curve that first decreases and then increases, a curve that first increases and then decreases, etc.; among them, label S corresponds to the conductometric titration curve that first decreases with added volume, reaches a minimum at a certain point, and then increases. Reasoning: when AgNO3 is added to KCl solution, the precipitation reaction Ag+ + Cl− → AgCl(s) occurs. Before the equivalence point, the added Ag+ is precipitated by Cl−, and the solution mainly contains K+ and NO3−, equivalent to gradually replacing Cl− with NO3−; due to changes in ionic mobility, conductance decreases slightly. When the equivalence point is reached, Cl− is basically consumed, and conductance reaches the minimum. After the equivalence point, excess AgNO3 remains in the solution, Ag+ and NO3− and other mobile ions increase, and conductance rises. Therefore the curve that first decreases and then rises after reaching the minimum should be selected, namely the label S in the figure.

raw_record.question_text: AgNO_3 (aq.) was added gradually to an aqueous KCl solution, and the conductivity of the solution was measured. Which plot of conductance ($\Lambda$) versus the volume of AgNO_3 matches this experiment?

method.method_draft: First describe the plotted alternatives and note which one has the expected conductometric-titration shape: an initial decrease, a minimum at the stoichiometric point, then an increase. From the text, recognize that AgNO3 is being added to KCl. Apply Ag+ + Cl− → AgCl(s): before all Cl− is precipitated, no free Ag+ accumulates and the solution changes from KCl toward KNO3, giving a slight decrease in conductance; after all Cl− is consumed, excess AgNO3 adds mobile ions and conductance rises. Match this decrease-then-increase curve to the image label S.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：题图上方文字说明“AgNO3(aq.) gradually added to aqueous KCl solution”，要求判断 conductance Λ 随 AgNO3 体积变化的曲线。下方有四个候选图，纵轴标为 Λ，横轴标为 volume。四个图分别呈现不同形状：有单调上升曲线，有先下降后上升的曲线，有先上升后下降的曲线等；其中标号 S 对应的是先随加入体积降低、在某一点达到最低值、之后再升高的 conductometric titration 曲线。推理：AgNO3 加入 KCl 溶液时发生沉淀反应 Ag+ + Cl− → AgCl(s)。在等当点以前，加入的 Ag+ 被 Cl− 沉淀掉，溶液中主要是 K+ 和 NO3−，相当于用 NO3−逐步替代 Cl−；由于离子迁移率变化，电导略有下降。到达等当点时 Cl− 基本消耗完，电导达到最低。等当点以后，过量 AgNO3 留在溶液中，Ag+ 和 NO3−等可移动离子增多，电导上升。因此应选择先下降、到最低点后上升的曲线，即图中标号 S。

method.method_draft: Set up the stoichiometric endpoint. Let initial moles of KCl be n0 and moles of added AgNO3 be cV. For V < Veq, Ag+ is precipitated, so the conducting ions are K+ with amount n0, Cl− with amount n0 − cV, and NO3− with amount cV. Thus Λ is governed by λK n0 + λCl(n0 − cV) + λNO3(cV), with dilution; because λNO3 is slightly less than λCl and dilution lowers conductance, the pre-equivalence slope is negative. For V > Veq, excess Ag+ remains, so the conducting-ion sum gains λAg(cV − n0) + λNO3(cV), giving a positive slope. Therefore the correct graph must have a minimum at the equivalence point and then rise; compare with the visual alternatives and choose S.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：题图下方给出若干个候选的 Λ 对 AgNO3 加入体积 volume 的曲线，纵轴标为 Λ，横轴标为 volume，并用竖直虚线标出一个特征体积。图中标为 S 的曲线是在虚线前随体积增加而下降，在虚线附近达到最低点，随后在虚线后又上升，整体呈先降后升并有最低点的形状。
推理：反应为 Ag+ + Cl− → AgCl(s)。设初始 KCl 的物质的量为 n0，加入 AgNO3 的物质的量为 cV，则等量点满足 cVeq = n0。V < Veq 时，加入的 Ag+ 都被 Cl− 沉淀掉，溶液中主要导电离子为 K+：n0，Cl−：n0 − cV，NO3−：cV。因此导电贡献可写作 λK n0 + λCl(n0 − cV) + λNO3(cV)，并且还受到加液稀释的影响。由于 NO3− 的摩尔电导略小于 Cl−，再加上稀释作用，等量点前 conductance Λ 应随 AgNO3 体积增加而降低。V > Veq 时，Cl− 已基本沉淀完全，过量 Ag+ 留在溶液中，导电离子为 K+、NO3− 以及过量 Ag+，导电贡献随 λAg(cV − n0) + λNO3(cV) 增加，所以等量点后 Λ 应上升。因此正确图像应在等量点处出现最小值，然后上升；与图中候选曲线比较，符合的是 S。
